thread:
maria_ops: Heads up — vendor sent a revised window for PO# 892134 and 892135, lead time slipped ~3w. Pricing holdback: vendor asking for +4% to lock earlier ship. We need to decide on a credit/expedite or accept later delivery.
leo_procure: thanks. can you paste their new ETA and which SKUs are affected?
maria_ops: ETA new: 2026-05-10 -> 2026-05-31 for main batch. Affected: H100-80GB x120, A800 x40. Vendor note: can ship 40 H100s earlier (2026-05-20) if we accept 4% expedite fee and cover expedited freight.
sanjay_infra: cluster health: two pools are dipping under reserve in us-west; if we lose 40 H100s we risk throttling ML inference for customer tier-1. We should prioritize at least 30 H100s to us-west asap.
leo_procure: we're negotiating. counter-offer: vendor will take 2.5% expedite fee and provide RMA buffer of 6 units (refundable credit if not used). pushback: they say sea->air uplift only for the partial wave.
maria_ops: 2.5% + 6-unit RMA buffer sounds reasonable. what's the delta in freight?
leo_procure: quick math: expedite freight per unit ~ $420 -> total uplift ~$17k. 2.5% on units value = ~$28k. total ~ $45k for earlier tranche. I can try to flip the RMA buffer to be credited against next invoice if unused.
ara_support: note on RMA — if we accept partial early shipment, we need clear return routing for DOA and a single consolidated AWB for returns. Otherwise depot sorting will double our processing time. Please confirm depot and contact.
maria_ops: depot = AMS-Depot-9 (EU) and SFO-Depot-B (US). prefer consolidated AWB to SFO for US returns. can vendor accept hub consolidation?
leo_procure: vendor open to SFO consolidation for returns but wants us to cover final-mile for returns from EU depot. proposing a returns credit of $1,200/unit for EU DOAs to cover brokerage.
sanjay_infra: operational ask: can we temporarily borrow 20 A800s from APAC pool until H100s arrive? That buys 10 days of headroom. Would need netsec tunnel + inventory tag change.
maria_ops: tagging and tunnel ok, but logistics needs a release ETA. leo, can you request a cross-pool loan agreement (10-day max) and confirm insurance cover?
leo_procure: already on it. asked vendor + our partner forwarder. flagged clause: cross-pool loans must include clear serial manifest and temporary custody affidavit.
rma_bot: Automated: Created RMA case #RMA-20260501-77 for potential DOA tranche; assigned to ara_support.
ara_support: acknowledged. I'll prep the return-flow doc and include the AWB template. dropping a snippet:
```
Return flow checklist:
- Single consolidated AWB (SFO) for US returns
- EU depot: photo evidence + serial match before acceptance
- Credit hold: 6-unit contingency pool
- Returns credit request template to vendor
```
maria_ops: thanks. final decision request: approve 2.5% expedite + vendor pays freight to hub; we cover final-mile EU returns credit up to $1,200/unit, and insist on 6-unit RMA buffer credited back if unused. Anyone object?
sanjay_infra: approve from infra side. we need commitment window in writing and a rollback policy if thermal failures >1.5% on arrival.
leo_procure: I'll push terms. will aim for written confirmation by EOD. if vendor rejects, fallback plan = accept full batch late and trigger APAC->US loan of A800s.
maria_ops: sounds good. I'll update the incident runbook and tag on-call. :thumbsup:
leo_procure: pinging vendor contact @HyperLogiX-sales (via email) now, copying terms.
ara_support: prepping AWB template and depot intake SOP.
rma_bot: Automated: Vendor acknowledged partial-express request; pending PO amendment.
